Welcome! You don't need an issue to contribute — the
[60-second path](https://github.com/Guyue-arch/fizzfest-bounty#-the-60-second-path-no-terminal)
in the README is the whole game — but if you're stuck, this is the right
door.

**Tell us where you tripped:**

- The step that got me:
- What I expected:
- What happened instead:

A maintainer or a passing fizzfriend will help. Nothing you ask here is
wasted: the fix usually becomes one line of README, so the next person
won't trip where you did.
